svg.title: OmniRet multi-modal query and candidate embedding architecture
svg.desc: Complete native SVG reconstruction. Base frames: main OmniRet model, query embedding label, candidate embedding label, query modality panel, candidate OmniRet header, candidate modality panel. Inventory: dashed loss arrows across top and left; green architecture with pooling, LLM+LoRA, media resampler, projectors and encoders; frozen/trainable legend; bottom query panel with instruction text, video strip, image, audio waveform and colored dotted links; right candidate panel with video, audio and image; grey up arrows and green dashed connection. Symmetry basis: main architecture is horizontally stacked and column-symmetric in visual/audio branches; query and candidate panels align vertically by media type.

g.desc: Frame inventory: green rounded model block containing stacked trainable/frozen modules. Origin is the top pooling bar, then conduction proceeds downward through LLM, shared resampler, paired projectors, paired encoders, and the OmniRet label. Horizontal symmetry separates visual branch left and audio branch right.

Frame inventory: mint rounded Omni Modality Query block. Origin is left instruction/query text; conduction proceeds rightward through dotted modality links to video filmstrip, image crop, and audio waveform. Video and image show stylized medical/person frames; audio is a green waveform labelled erhu sound. Panel is balanced around a horizontal media row.
Candidate OmniRet header receives an upward arrow from the pink candidate media block and sends a black arrow to candidate embedding. It aligns with the main architecture output.

Frame inventory: pink rounded Omni Modality Candidate block. Origin is the top Video label; conduction proceeds rightward to filmstrip, downward to audio waveform and quoted violin sound, downward to image, then to caption. Vertical equipartition follows Video, Audio, Image rows.
